title: Record pages in Setup (Organization, the permission-set page) carry two nested <main> landmarks, so screen readers announce two main regions — keep one (hotcrm#2194 T2-U23)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** Setup 的记录页（组织、权限集）嵌套了两个 `<main>` 地标，读屏软件会报两个主区域。
- **要做：** 每页只保留一个 `main` 地标。
- **完成标准：** 这些页面只有一个 `main`。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U23**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** record pages in Setup (Organization in round 1; the permission-set page in round 2), keyboard and screen-reader users.
- **Now:** two nested `<main>` landmarks; screen readers announce two main regions.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-23 (a DOM reading, no screenshot); round 2 measured it unchanged on the permission-set page ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), opening paragraph).

## Landing

Read on objectui `origin/main` `74ebad09`, `<main` in `packages/app-shell/src`:
- `components/AppShell.tsx` ~:24 wraps the route in `<main>`; `console/organizations/manage/OrganizationLayout.tsx` ~:130, `OrganizationsLayout.tsx` ~:32 and `console/home/HomeLayout.tsx` ~:130 add their own. `layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx` ~:98 already notes that `<main>` belongs to one layer.
- The inner ones become a non-landmark element (or the outer one moves), whichever keeps the skip link's target.

## Done when

- Every Setup record page, the Organization and permission-set pages included, has exactly one `main` landmark (an axe or DOM test).
- The skip-to-content target still works.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `landmark`, `main region`, `a11y`, `accessib`. 1 hit: #13224 (closed, Audit Log filter names), not on point. **New.**
